Class WhoMappingCheck

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.spring.security.web.WhoMappingCheck
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.beans.factory.SmartInitializingSingleton
public final class WhoMappingCheck extends Object implements org.springframework.beans.factory.SmartInitializingSingleton
Fails startup when who's controllers would not answer where who's sign-in filters, logout, public paths and error handling expect them: at WhoPaths.of(String). Each of who's own controller mappings declared under WhoPaths.MAPPING must resolve to one of its declared paths there (an application's controller that uses the constant is not checked), so a path prefix the application puts on its controllers, a WhoPaths bean whose root is not who.base-path, or a spring.mvc.servlet.path other than / is refused, naming the mapping.
